method: histology <-> blockface slice match of every tracer-labeled piece, by image similarity.
Per labeled piece (labels/push_tracer_r058/<S>/push_tracer_<S>.json; the registrations of the labels' arm: data_arm_preinp_r058 for MR243,
MR256, MF191, data_arm_preinp for MR252): the histology after the piece's own LINEAR registration (TIRL moving3_affine.png, on the blockface
piece canvas = the store's level-0 slice turned 180 deg, histo.match_b2h) against the blockface photograph of the slice of record and of the
slices around it (the arm's store, the tubes-visible store steps/<S>_03_color.ome.zarr, level 0, turned the same way), inside the histology's
tissue footprint: normalized mutual information (NMI, 32 bins; luminance) and |NCC|. Range: MR243 (0.366 mm slices) and MF191 (0.75 mm)
+-8 slices; MR252 and MR256 (0.045 mm slices) +-64 slices in steps of 4 (+-2.9 mm). The scan inherits the record slice's linear alignment
(the histology is not re-registered to each candidate), so it is biased towards the slice of record: an offset found despite this bias is
strong evidence. Per piece: slice of record, best slice by NMI, offset (slices, mm), the NMI curve, the margin (NMI best - NMI at the
record slice). Flag: |offset| >= 0.7 mm (two MF8 / MM1 slices). Check: the fixed image of record (fixed.png) must correlate with the store
slice of record inside its own footprint (the slice extraction is validated per piece).
-> paper/numbers/tracer_match_audit_r058.json (+ labels/r058/match_audit/<S>.npz: the curves for the sheets)
